item.title: How to Choose an Electric Bicycle for Everyday Riding in Australia
item.summary: An electric bike can make an ordinary trip surprisingly different. A hill that used to decide whether you drove or cycled becomes far less important. Five kilometres to the shops no longer feels like much of a commitment. Even a strong afternoon headwind becomes more of an annoyance than a reason to leave the bike [...] The post How to Choose an Electric Bicycle for Everyday Riding in Australia appeared first on Tech Guide .
